text: Worst customer support Extremely disappointed with Blinkit. I ordered a set of makeup brushes, and the quality was terrible. The bristles were loose and kept falling out, making the product unusable. What made the experience even worse was the customer support. The chat executive, Samiya, closed the chat before even listening to my complete issue. Instead of trying to help or provide a solution, I was misled and simply told that the product could not be returned. I have placed many orders with Blinkit as a regular customer, but it seems the company takes no responsibility when a customer receives a defective product. This is the worst customer service I have experienced. If this is how loyal customers are treated, I would rather order from platforms that actually stand behind the products they sell and support their customers when something goes wrong. Very disappointing experience. I will think twice before ordering from Blinkit again.
text_raw:
Worst customer support

Extremely disappointed with Blinkit. I ordered a set of makeup brushes, and the quality was terrible. The bristles were loose and kept falling out, making the product unusable.

What made the experience even worse was the customer support. The chat executive, Samiya, closed the chat before even listening to my complete issue. Instead of trying to help or provide a solution, I was misled and simply told that the product could not be returned.

I have placed many orders with Blinkit as a regular customer, but it seems the company takes no responsibility when a customer receives a defective product. This is the worst customer service I have experienced. If this is how loyal customers are treated, I would rather order from platforms that actually stand behind the products they sell and support their customers when something goes wrong.

Very disappointing experience. I will think twice before ordering from Blinkit again.
